metadata.description: `by-purl/<slug>.jsonl` — one line of the PURL inverted index, epoch 1 (PROP-005 §2.13): a package version whose package- or subskill-level `describes` matches one given PURL. Root type `PurlRow`; every field required. Source of truth for `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/index/e1/by_purl/`.
The package URL this row indexes — the canonical spelling as it lives inside the entry, not the filesystem-safe slug that names the file.

Where the PURL was declared on the entry — `package` for the top-level `describes`, `subskill` for a subskill's. Closed vocabulary: paths are built from these values, so an unfamiliar one has no safe behaviour. The wire strings are the WRITER's form (`kebab-case` in `vibe-index`); the reader-side copy in `vibe-registry` spells them `lowercase`, which coincides only because both variants are single words — Phase 4.2 converges the two by re-export.
